rules.key: You must include a Chaos Warmaster in your fleet
rules.text: You must include a Chaos Warmaster in your fleet, even if it is worth 750 points or less.
rules.why: Ainoa lista jossa komentaja on pakollinen ilman pisterajaa. Kirjan lause kieltaa rajan nimenomaisesti, joten yleiset kaavat eivat voi sita tunnistaa; kirjattu kasin RULE_PICKS-taulussa pisterajalla 0.

rules.key: He must be assigned to the biggest (ie, most expensive) ship
rules.text: He must be assigned to the biggest (ie, most expensive) ship and improves its Leadership to the value shown below.

rules.key: they may be given up to four Marks of Chaos
rules.text: In addition they may be given up to four Marks of Chaos as shown below (no Mark may be taken more than once).
rules.why: Warmaster saa NELJA merkkia, Chaos Lord vain yhden. Sovellus estaa saman merkin kahdesti ryhmalogiikalla, mutta maaraa nelja tai yksi ei valvota.

rules.key: You may include up to three Chaos Lords in your fleet
rules.text: You may include up to three Chaos Lords in your fleet.
rules.why: Kirja kirjoittaa taman rajan kahdesti: otsikkona ja lauseena. Sovellus naytti niista kaksi identtista riviä, kunnes ne yhdistettiin 7.9.2026. Jaljelle jaa yksi tarkistus, jonka lahdelause on kirjan taysi virke.

rules.key: A Chaos Lord may be given up to one of the following Marks of Chaos
rules.text: A Chaos Lord may be given up to one of the following Marks of Chaos.
rules.why: Yhden merkin raja per Lord; sovellus ei laske merkkeja komentajakohtaisesti.

rules.key: You may include up to one Space Hulk in the fleet
rules.text: You may include up to one Space Hulk in the fleet. See its profile for restrictions and how to include it.
rules.why: Kirja kirjoittaa taman rajan kahdesti: otsikkona ja lauseena. Sovellus naytti niista kaksi identtista riviä, kunnes ne yhdistettiin 7.9.2026. Jaljelle jaa yksi tarkistus, jonka lahdelause on kirjan taysi virke.

rules.key: one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers.
rules.why: Nimittaja kattaa molemmat tyypit vasta 7.9.2026 jalkeen; ennen sita 'or heavy cruisers' typistyi pois ja tarkistus oli liian tiukka.

rules.key: one grand cruiser in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one grand cruiser in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers.

rules.key: one heavy cruiser in your fleet for every two cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one heavy cruiser in your fleet for every two cruisers.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: Ships with launch bays can have a mixture
rules.text: Ships with launch bays can have a mixture of Swiftdeath fighters, Doomfire bombers or Dreadclaw assault craft. Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with normal and boarding torpedoes.
rules.why: Kirjan lause nakyy osion tekstina. Ordnance-tyyppi valitaan pelin aikana, joten valvottavaa ei ole. (Aiemmin 'not_shown': RULEY ei tuntenut sanaa 'can', 7.9.2026 korjattu.)

rules.key: one cruiser from any Imperial Navy fleet list up to 185 points
rules.text: For every 1,500 points in a Chaos fleet, one cruiser from any Imperial Navy fleet list up to 185 points and/or up to six Imperial Navy escorts may be taken. Special weapon rules, Nova Cannon, Chaos Lords, Chaos Space Marines, Chaos ordnance or Daemonship upgrades may not be taken for Imperial Navy vessels used in this manner, and cruisers suffer -1Ld for going renegade. Imperial Navy escorts need not be in a single squadron and may be interspersed within other Chaos escort squadrons if desired. These vessels may not take any upgrade listed in their profile and do not count as reserves; they count as Chaos vessels in all respects.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): oma osio RENEGADE IMPERIAL VESSELS, jossa Imperiumin rungot (risteilijat enintaan 185 p ja saattajat) ilman profiilipaivityksia (noopt). Kaksi per_points-saantoa: yksi risteilija ja kuusi saattajaa per TAYSI 1500 pistetta (lause ei sano 'or part thereof'). Lauseen loppu 'they count as Chaos vessels in all respects' toteutuu silla, etta listan oma 0-12 Cruisers ja saattajalaivuesaanto laskevat nama mukaan (section_count.pick). Sivu 222 ei mahdu listojen saantoikkunaan (lists.py rules_pages, kuusi sivua), joten osion teksti kantaa lauseen pelaajalle.

notes: Sivut 226-231 ovat Chaosin jaetut saannot: daemonshipien warp-translaatio, haunting, kampanjasaannot ja Chaos Promotions -taulukko. Ne ovat pelin- ja kampanjanaikaisia.
Tama on Chaosin peruslista. Muut viisi ovat sen muunnelmia, ja niissa komentaja on pakollinen vasta 750 pisteesta.
Merkit (Marks of Chaos) ovat samat neljä molemmilla komentajilla, mutta Warmaster saa nelja ja Lord yhden. Sita eroa ei valvota.

Talla listalla EI OLE DAEMON SHIPS -osiota. Se on kirjan mukaista: sivuilla 232-233 ei ole sellaista otsikkoa eika hinnastoa, vaan daemonship-hinnat on painettu vasta Black Crusade -listan sivulle 235. Jaettujen saantojen lause 'Any number of capital ships can be upgraded to Daemon ships' nakyy FLEET RULES -lohkossa, mutta rivia ei tarjota - eika pidakaan, koska talla listalla ei ole hintaa.
